attchmntText: Intimation regarding postponement of the 67th (Sixty Seventh) meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC).
voiceSummary: Videocon Industries Limited has postponed its 67th Committee of Creditors meeting, originally scheduled for November 20, 2026. The postponement was requested by the Committee of Creditors. The meeting concerns the consolidated corporate insolvency resolution process for Videocon Industries Limited and twelve other Videocon group companies. The revised date and time for the meeting will be communicated at a later stage. The company is currently under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by National Company Law Tribunal order dated June 6, 2018. Abhijit Guhathakurta is the Resolution Professional for the thirteen Videocon group companies.

attchmntText: Pre-facto intimation of the upcoming 67th meeting of the Committee of Creditors to be held on November 20, 2026.
voiceSummary: Videocon Industries Limited has issued a pre-facto intimation regarding the 67th meeting of the consolidated Committee of Creditors. The meeting involves Videocon Industries Limited and 12 other Videocon group companies under a consolidated corporate insolvency resolution process. The session is scheduled for Friday, November 20, 2026. The intimation is provided in accordance with Regulation 19 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India regulations. The company is under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by NCLT order dated 6th June, 2018. Abhijit Guhathakurta serves as the Resolution Professional for the 13 Videocon group companies. Responses to the meeting notice should be emailed to inrpvil@deloitte.com.
